review_note: Independent mathematical review confirmed the oracle is the exact Gaussian marginal, y ~ N(X beta, sigma^2 I + J K J'), with K = kronecker(cov2cor(vcv(tree2)), cov2cor(vcv(tree1))) built from ape::vcv and the fitted SD coefficients applied to the data-generating predictor, using no drmTMB code and no Laplace approximation; agreement is 1e-6 relative. Both rows are run through the same oracle: phylo_interaction intercept (mu:I) and slope-only (mu:x1..xp), identity link, tree_pair input. Emulated-bug sensitivity exists and exceeds 1e-2: reversed, shuffled and swapped SD vectors, a constant mean SD, and the raw non-standardised K. The test also covers constant-SD equivalence, row-order invariance, an ordinary plant intercept beside the slope (exact marginal with extra V), a different-predictor likelihood change, save/reload and refusals. Covers native Gaussian phylogenetic-interaction mean SD on synthetic fixtures; does not establish calibration, recovery beyond the 0.5 band, Julia parity, the sigma endpoint, or the intercept-plus-slope block (refused).
